data.title: Golf Dale
data.about:
Golf Dale is the latest launch in the heart of Emaar South, strategically positioned along Dubai–Al Ain Road. This elegant building by Emaar offers breathtaking views of lush green hills, pristine fairways, and the championship Emaar South Golf Course. Residents can choose from thoughtfully designed 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and exclusive 3-bedroom townhouses, featuring modern designs, natural materials, and earthy tones for a sophisticated ambiance.

The community offers a golf-inspired lifestyle with access to an 18-hole championship golf course, a state-of-the-art clubhouse, and fine dining options. A variety of world-class amenities include jogging tracks, yoga decks, outdoor gyms, adult and kids' swimming pools, and BBQ areas. This development by Emaar ensures a balanced and wellness-oriented lifestyle, making it an ideal choice for individuals and families seeking refined living in a well-connected location.

characteristics_module.title: Golf Dale by Emaar: Your Green Escape Awaits!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Strategically situated in Emaar South along Dubai–Al Ain Road, offering seamless connectivity to key destinations such as Al Maktoum International Airport, Downtown Dubai, and Dubai Marina.
  • Golf-Inspired Lifestyle: Residents enjoy access to an 18-hole championship golf course, a top-tier clubhouse, and breathtaking views of fairways and lush greenery.
  • Modern Design: Apartments and townhouses feature contemporary designs with earthy tones and natural materials, creating a sophisticated and tranquil living environment.
  • Wellness-Focused Amenities: Includes jogging tracks, yoga decks, outdoor gyms, swimming pools, and BBQareas, promoting a balanced and active lifestyle.
  • Eco-Friendly Community: Offers sustainable community parks with kids' play areas, a retail plaza, and multipurpose courts, fostering a family-friendly and socially vibrant environment.
  • Trusted Developer: Developed by Emaar, a globally renowned real estate brand with a proven track record of delivering iconic projects like Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall.
  • Diverse Living Options: Offers a variety of units, including 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and exclusive 3-bedroom townhouses, catering to a wide range of lifestyle needs.

location_tile.title: Golf Dale: Nestled Amidst the Fairways of Emaar South Golf Course
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Located in the heart of Emaar South, Golf Dale offers residents unparalleled connectivity and convenience. Strategically positioned along Dubai–Al Ain Road, the community is just 5 minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport, 30 minutes from Dubai Marina, and 35 minutes from Downtown Dubai and the iconic Burj Khalifa.The community's central position ensures seamless access to retail, healthcare, education, and recreation facilities, making it an ideal destination for families and professionals alike.

  • 5 Minutes - Al Maktoum International Airport
  • 30 Minutes - Dubai Marina 
  • 35 Minutes - Downtown Dubai
  • 50 - Minutes - Abu Dhabi City Center
